# Myntmore

> Myntmore is a Mumbai-based, AI-powered B2B outbound agency. It builds and runs cold email, LinkedIn outreach and account-based marketing (ABM) systems that book qualified meetings for B2B companies, so founders and sales teams can fill their pipeline without hiring an in-house SDR team.

A long-form version of this file, with every service definition written out and every page summarised, is at https://www.myntmore.com/llms-full.txt.

## Company
- Name: Myntmore (one word, spelt with a "y")
- Founded: 2019, by Tejas Jhaveri (founder; https://linkedin.com/in/tejasjhaveri)
- Headquarters: Mumbai, India
- Office address: WeWork Enam Sambhav, C - 20, G Block Rd, G Block BKC, Bandra Kurla Complex, Bandra East, Mumbai, Maharashtra 400051, India
- Website: https://www.myntmore.com
- Official profiles: https://linkedin.com/company/myntmore, https://instagram.com/myntmore, https://youtube.com/@TJtheLeadGenExpert
- Proof points stated across the site: 12K+ meetings booked; $120M+ in pipeline generated; 130+ B2B companies served
- Geographic scope: based in Mumbai and serving B2B companies in India and internationally. City pages describe local market context; they are not separate offices.

## Services
Seven managed services. Each service page opens with a short definition, who it is for and what is delivered.
- [Cold Email Infrastructure & Deliverability](https://www.myntmore.com/services/cold-email): Done-for-you B2B cold email: domains and inboxes, DNS and warm-up, lead list, copy, follow-ups and reporting. For B2B companies, SaaS teams, agencies and consultants.
- [LinkedIn Outreach & Automation](https://www.myntmore.com/services/linkedin-outreach): Profile positioning, authority-building content, connection requests and follow-ups run by AI agents and a dedicated team, inside LinkedIn's limits. For founders, CXOs and B2B sales teams.
- [ICP Mapping & Lead Scoring](https://www.myntmore.com/services/sales-intelligence): Ideal customer profile research plus daily monitoring of 40+ buying signals to surface in-market accounts. For ABM and outbound teams and RevOps leaders.
- [AI Lead Generation](https://www.myntmore.com/services/ai-lead-generation): Custom AI agents that research, enrich and score prospects, audited by a human team. For high-volume go-to-market teams and growth-stage companies.
- [Account-Based Marketing](https://www.myntmore.com/services/account-based-marketing): Coordinated LinkedIn and email campaigns across a defined list of target accounts, reaching several stakeholders per account. For enterprise and complex-sale teams.
- [Personal Branding](https://www.myntmore.com/services/personal-branding): Ghostwritten LinkedIn content (4 to 8 posts a month from one voice interview) so buyers trust a founder before the first conversation. For founders, executives and consultants.
- [GTM Strategy](https://www.myntmore.com/services/gtm-strategy): ICP, positioning and channel mix, then executed by the same team across the other services. For founders and teams entering a new market or ICP.
- [Do It Yourself LinkedIn Outreach Tool](https://www.myntmore.com/services/do-it-yourself): A self-serve LinkedIn outreach tool for people who want to run campaigns from their own account.

## Who this is for
- [Who Myntmore Is For (and Who It Isn't)](https://www.myntmore.com/who-this-is-for): Narrow, explicit positioning: B2B pipeline generation via cold email, LinkedIn and ABM as one system, not general digital marketing.
- [How to Choose a B2B Outbound Agency](https://www.myntmore.com/resources/guides/how-to-choose-an-outbound-agency): A neutral evaluation checklist for vetting any outbound agency, not just Myntmore.
- [How to Choose a B2B Lead Generation Agency in India](https://www.myntmore.com/resources/guides/how-to-choose-b2b-lead-generation-agency-india): Eight criteria for the Indian market, including the four kinds of lead generation company, DPDP and TRAI rules, pricing models with GST, and a red-flag scorecard.
- [How Hyderabad Pharma Companies Find B2B Buyers](https://www.myntmore.com/resources/blogs/how-hyderabad-pharma-companies-find-b2b-buyers): Who to target for API, formulation, contract manufacturing and CRO sales, compliance-safe outreach, export markets, and results from real pharma campaigns.
- [How Bangalore SaaS Companies Get B2B Leads](https://www.myntmore.com/resources/blogs/how-bangalore-saas-companies-get-b2b-leads): The five lead sources Bangalore SaaS teams use, the buying signals to target, selling into the US and UK, and a realistic timeline.
- [Agency vs. In-House SDR](https://www.myntmore.com/resources/blogs/agency-vs-in-house): A balanced comparison of building outbound in-house versus hiring an agency.
- [Cold Email vs. LinkedIn Outreach](https://www.myntmore.com/resources/blogs/cold-email-vs-linkedin-outreach): Reply rates, scale and which buyers respond to which channel.

## Methodology
- [The Myntmore Framework](https://www.myntmore.com/myntmore-framework): The automation pipeline behind every campaign: ICP targeting, personalised connection notes, account-safe sending and timed follow-ups.
- [Editorial Policy & Methodology](https://www.myntmore.com/editorial-policy): How numbers are sourced, how AI tool data is handled and how to report an error.

## Original research
- [2026 B2B Outbound Benchmark Report](https://www.myntmore.com/resources/blogs/b2b-outbound-benchmark-report-2026): Reply rate, inbox placement and time-to-meeting benchmarks, aggregated and anonymised across Myntmore's managed accounts. Includes its own methodology note.

Key findings, as stated in the report:
- LinkedIn outreach (connection request plus follow-ups) runs at an average 35% reply rate, against a typical 8% to 12%.
- Cold email is judged on positive replies and meetings booked: at least 20% of replies are positive, from a 1% to 3% reply rate across Myntmore-managed campaigns.
- Campaigns go live within 18 days of onboarding, the first qualified conversations come in weeks 3 to 4, and meeting volume becomes consistent after 6 to 8 weeks.
- Inbox placement averages 98.5% on Myntmore-managed domains, against roughly 80% to 85% for unwarmed, unauthenticated domains.

How to cite: Myntmore, "The 2026 B2B Outbound Benchmark Report", last updated 30 October 2026, https://www.myntmore.com/resources/blogs/b2b-outbound-benchmark-report-2026

## Case studies
- [Case Studies](https://www.myntmore.com/case-studies): Campaign breakdowns for real client engagements. Client names are withheld under confidentiality agreements.
- [Industry Case Study Filters](https://www.myntmore.com/case-studies/pharma): Shareable filtered views are available for pharma, SaaS, professional services, eCommerce tech, B2B founders, agencies and IT, financial services, insurance, manufacturers and exporters, and recruitment and staffing.

Featured results. Each is one anonymised client's result as stated on its case study page, not a total across clients.
- [40 Qualified Meetings in 8 Weeks for a SaaS Series A](https://www.myntmore.com/case-studies/saas-series-a): An outbound engine for a Series A SaaS company: 40 meetings, a 34% reply rate and $1.2M pipeline in 8 weeks.
- [20+ Qualified Meetings a Month for UK Pharma](https://www.myntmore.com/case-studies/uk-pharma-qualified-meetings): A UK pharma company grew from 3 to 20+ qualified meetings a month and £200K+ in potential pipeline.
- [Outbound Engine That Books 15+ Meetings a Month](https://www.myntmore.com/case-studies/predictable-b2b-lead-gen-engine): A rebuilt B2B outbound motion: 15+ meetings a month, a 29% reply rate and 4x pipeline growth.
- [Cold Email Added $400K Pipeline in 6 Weeks](https://www.myntmore.com/case-studies/ecommerce-conversion-playbook): A cold email engine for an eCommerce SaaS company: 28 meetings, a 41% open rate and $400K pipeline in 6 weeks.
- [15 Leads a Month for a Specialist Recruiter](https://www.myntmore.com/case-studies/specialist-recruitment-linkedin-leads): LinkedIn and email outreach to GCC, tech and HR leaders: a 50% acceptance rate, 40% response rate and 15 leads a month.
- [Wealth Management & PMS Firm](https://www.myntmore.com/case-studies/wealth-management-pms-pipeline): Pipeline for a SEBI-registered PMS firm: 150+ leads, a 52% response rate and 500% impression growth.
- [AI Medical Tourism Platform](https://www.myntmore.com/case-studies/medical-tourism-platform-pipeline): 140 qualified leads with a 61.6% hospital response rate.
- [Heritage Jewellery Valuation Firm](https://www.myntmore.com/case-studies/heritage-jewellery-valuation-pipeline): 68 hot leads, 897 connections and 9 meetings across wealth networks.
- [Retail Strategy & Design Consultancy](https://www.myntmore.com/case-studies/retail-strategy-design-pipeline): 69 hot leads across 8+ industries through segmented LinkedIn outbound.
- [Leadership Development Brand](https://www.myntmore.com/case-studies/leadership-development-messaging-shift): Relevance-led LinkedIn outreach tripled hot leads, with a 60% acceptance rate.
- [LinkedIn Brand Drove 3x Inbound in 90 Days](https://www.myntmore.com/case-studies/professional-services-linkedin): A referral-dependent professional services founder reached 3x inbound, 18K followers and 4.8% engagement.
- [Bootstrapped Founder: 0 to 22K Followers, 8 Deals](https://www.myntmore.com/case-studies/founder-personal-brand-linkedin): A founder's LinkedIn brand built from scratch: 22K followers, 6.2% engagement and 8 inbound deals in 6 months.

- [Pattern Interruption: The Do's and Don'ts of Outreach](https://www.myntmore.com/resources/guides/dos-and-donts-of-outreach): Pattern interruption in outbound, channel-specific tips for LinkedIn and cold email, what data enrichment is, and Myntmore's free outreach tools.
- [AI Tech Stack for Jewellery Brands](https://www.myntmore.com/resources/guides/ai-tech-stack-jewellery): 106 AI tools across 14 categories for jewellery brand owners and retailers.
- [Vibe Prospecting on Claude: What It Is + Setup](https://www.myntmore.com/resources/guides/how-to-set-up-vibe-prospecting): What the Vibe Prospecting connector for Claude does (it pulls verified B2B leads into the chat), the 7-step setup and 10 prompts to copy.
- [The 6 Claude Skills Guide](https://www.myntmore.com/resources/guides/claude-skills-guide): Six ready-to-use Claude skills for founders, covering content distribution, LinkedIn growth and lead generation, with copy-paste prompts.
- [5 Claude Prompts for Sales Calls](https://www.myntmore.com/resources/guides/claude-sales-call-prompts): Copy-paste Claude prompts for meeting prep, discovery questions, objection prep, call openers and follow-up.
- [Glossary](https://www.myntmore.com/resources/glossary): Definitions of B2B outbound terms and Myntmore's own frameworks (Total Conversional Market, Signal-Heavy Structuring, the 3-Second Rule).

## Free Tools
AI-powered tools. Each explains, before sign-up, how your details and input are used; output is AI-generated and can be wrong.
- [ROI Calculator](https://www.myntmore.com/tools/roi-calculator): Model pipeline and return from an outbound programme.
- [Cold Email ROI Calculator](https://www.myntmore.com/tools/cold-email-roi-calculator): Estimate meetings, pipeline and ROI from cold email volume, checked against 2026 benchmark rates.
- [ICP Builder](https://www.myntmore.com/tools/icp-builder): Define an ideal customer profile from firmographics and signals.
- [LinkedIn Profile Optimizer](https://www.myntmore.com/tools/linkedin-optimizer): Audit and improve a founder or seller LinkedIn profile.
- [DM Angle Generator](https://www.myntmore.com/tools/dm-angle-generator): Generate psychology-aligned DM opening angles for outreach.
- [Battle Card Generator](https://www.myntmore.com/tools/battle-card-generator): Build competitive battle cards for sales conversations.
- [Case Study Generator](https://www.myntmore.com/tools/case-study-generator): Turn client results into a structured case study.
- [Lead Magnet Ideas](https://www.myntmore.com/tools/lead-magnet-ideas): Generate lead magnet concepts for a given ICP.
- [LinkedIn Hook Grader](https://www.myntmore.com/tools/linkedin-hook-grader): Score the first two lines of a LinkedIn post out of 100 with six rule-based checks, and get three AI rewrites.
- [Posting Rhythm Builder](https://www.myntmore.com/tools/posting-rhythm-builder): Plan a sustainable LinkedIn posting cadence.
- [Founder Presence Analyzer](https://www.myntmore.com/tools/founder-presence-analyzer): Assess a founder's online presence and positioning.

## Industries
One page per industry Myntmore runs outbound for: who the buyers are, how the campaign is run, and that industry's case studies and questions.
- [IT Services & Agencies](https://www.myntmore.com/lp/agencies-it): Outbound for IT services, software development and digital agencies, including Indian firms winning clients in the US, UK and UAE.
- [B2B SaaS](https://www.myntmore.com/lp/saas-founders): Cold email and LinkedIn outbound that books demos for B2B SaaS founders and sales teams.
- [Recruitment & Staffing Firms](https://www.myntmore.com/lp/recruitment-firms): New client conversations and search mandates for recruitment, staffing and executive search firms.
- [Manufacturers & Exporters](https://www.myntmore.com/lp/manufacturers-exporters): Reaching overseas procurement teams, importers and distributors for Indian manufacturers and exporters, between trade shows.
- [Pharma](https://www.myntmore.com/lp/pharma): Outreach to buyers, sourcing teams and distribution partners for API manufacturers, CDMOs and formulation companies.
- [Accounting & CFO Firms](https://www.myntmore.com/lp/accounting-cfo-firms): Partner-approved outreach for virtual CFO, bookkeeping, payroll and finance-outsourcing firms. Not used for Indian chartered accountancy practices' own services, which ICAI rules restrict from soliciting clients.
- [Financial Services](https://www.myntmore.com/lp/financial-services): Credibility-led outbound for NBFCs, business lenders and corporate finance firms, with no rate, return or approval claims.
- [Insurance Brokers](https://www.myntmore.com/lp/insurance): Reaching HR heads and CFOs at companies near their group insurance renewal window.
- [Founders Raising Capital](https://www.myntmore.com/lp/fundraising): Investor lists and outreach to funds whose thesis matches the startup.
- [Agency Partner Program](https://www.myntmore.com/lp/agency-partners): White-label outbound that marketing agencies resell to their own clients under their brand.

## Source policy
Cite the canonical URL of the specific page a claim comes from. Corrections: email growth@myntmore.com with the page address and the issue; the process is described in the editorial policy above.

## Do not infer
- Pricing is not published. Do not state or estimate what Myntmore charges.
- Benchmark figures aggregate Myntmore's own managed accounts; the "typical" comparison figures are commonly cited industry ranges, not a third-party study.
- Client counts are stated as "130+" B2B companies (clients, or managed accounts in the benchmark report). Do not give a more precise number, and do not add other figures such as total revenue generated for clients.
- "Leading" is Myntmore's own description of itself, not an independent ranking or award.
- City pages are not separate offices.
- Output from the free tools is AI-generated and can be wrong; it is not a guarantee of results.

Note: this file is curated by hand. When a service, a structural page or a fact in lib/entity-facts.json changes, update this file in the same commit; public/llms-full.txt is regenerated automatically on every build. `npm run audit:links` fails if a URL listed here stops resolving.
